verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform, and such platforms can plausibly offer configurable automations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations. Payment plans, recurring payment links, webhooks and sandbox test keys are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
